extraction_notes: Figure 2c stability plot (Co–N–C at 350 °C for 102 h) contains many closely spaced points and no printed numeric rate values; it was not extracted point-by-point because reliable readings are not possible from the provided image. Supplementary figures/tables are cited in the text but not provided; only exact values quoted in the main text from those supplementary items were extracted. Figure 2d Arrhenius plot was not separately extracted because it duplicates rate information and is primarily used to report activation energies.
